oracle_provenance: Standard, widely-used requirements-engineering traceability coverage metric; independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded requirement-to-test traceability coverage percentage; not an audit of link quality or test-pass status.

cases.question: Does 85% coverage clear an 80% minimum threshold?
Does 40% coverage correctly fail the same 80% minimum threshold?
Must a covered-requirement count exceeding the total be rejected as structurally impossible?
When every requirement is covered, does the model correctly report exactly 100% with zero uncovered, its own trivial self-consistency check?
